title: 第5章 暗夜出手横扫群敌第6章 声名渐起潜修不辍
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 狭小木屋之内，夜色沉沉，气氛瞬间紧绷到极致。
赵虎带着四名帮手，呈合围之势，从四面八方朝着林宸猛扑过来。
每个人脚下都有灵力起伏涌动，出手之间拳风呼啸，带着平日里欺压弱小的蛮横霸道。
他们笃定五人联手，以多欺少，拿下一个炼气一层的林宸，根本不费吹灰之力。
在他们眼中，林宸白天不过是偷袭得手，占了先机，真要正面硬拼，根本不堪一击。
拳头裹挟着劲风，直逼林宸面门与周身要害。
招式粗鲁，毫无章法，全凭一身蛮力和粗浅修为逞凶。
换做普通杂役弟子，面对这般围攻，早就慌了心神，手足无措，只能被动挨打。
但林宸立身原地，神色自始至终平静无波。
眼眸冷冽如寒潭，将五人的攻势尽收眼底，快慢虚实，破绽落点，一目了然。
前世纵横修真界，经历过无数生死搏杀，见过的惊天对决数不胜数。
眼前这种底层小辈的斗殴，招式简陋，套路粗浅，在他眼里如同孩童打闹一般可笑。
面对四面袭来的拳脚，林宸不慌不忙，脚步轻轻挪移。
身形如同风中闲云，看似缓慢，却总能恰到好处避开每一道攻势。
拳脚擦着他的衣角、身侧掠过，带起阵阵冷风，却连皮毛都碰不到分毫。
几人接连出手，却全部落空，心中皆是一惊。
原本以为手到擒来，没想到林宸的身法竟然灵动到这种地步。
“别给他躲闪的机会，一起压上去！”
赵虎面色阴沉，厉声低喝，手上力道再加三分，攻势越发迅猛。
其余四人闻言，立刻加紧攻势，拳脚轮番齐出，封死林宸所有闪避空间。
狭小的木屋之中，掌风拳影交织，场面看着凶险万分。
可林宸始终镇定自若，心境没有丝毫波澜。
他不急不躁，身形辗转腾挪，每一步都踩得极稳，恰到好处避开所有攻击。
同时目光冷静扫视众人，默默看清每个人的路数和气力深浅。
这五人，修为都停留在炼气三层左右，底子浅薄，修行功法粗陋。
全靠日积月累劳作打磨体魄，再加上宗门最基础的吐纳心法，勉强凝住一丝灵力。
论真正搏杀之道，连入门都算不上。
片刻闪避过后，林宸已然摸清所有人的路数，眼底掠过一抹冷意。
一味躲闪没有意义，既然对方不知进退执意寻衅，那就干脆雷霆镇压，一次性打服打怕。
免得日后隔三差五前来纠缠，徒增麻烦。
就在又一道拳头迎面轰来的瞬间，林宸不再闪避。
侧身微转，右手倏然探出，快如电光石火。
精准扣住对方手腕，指尖运力，拿捏脉门。
咔嚓一声轻响，骨节脆响入耳。
那名弟子惨叫一声，整条手臂瞬间发麻无力，剧痛顺着腕脉蔓延全身，浑身灵力瞬间散乱，再也提不起半分力道。
content_en:
Inside the small wooden house, the night was dark and the atmosphere was tense to the extreme.
Zhao Hu and four helpers formed an encirclement and rushed towards Lin Chen from all directions.
Spiritual energy surged up and down under everyone's feet, and the fists roared as they struck, showing a tyrannical and overbearing attitude that usually bullies the weak.
They determined that the five of them would join forces and bully the few, and they would take down Lin Chen, who was at the first level of Qi Refining, without any effort at all.
In their eyes, Lin Chen only succeeded in a sneak attack during the day and gained an advantage. If he really wanted to fight head-on, he would be completely vulnerable.
The fist was wrapped in strong wind, and it was directed towards Lin Chen's face and vital parts of his body.
The moves are crude and unorganized, relying solely on brute force and superficial cultivation to achieve the goal.
If it were an ordinary handyman disciple, faced with such a siege, he would have been panicked and at a loss what to do, and could only passively take the beating.
But Lin Chen stood where he was, his expression calm from beginning to end.
His eyes were as cold as a cold pool, and he could see all the five people's attacks. The speed, reality, and weakness of the attacks were all clear at a glance.
In his previous life, he traveled across the world of cultivation, experienced numerous life-and-death battles, and witnessed countless shocking duels.
The fights between the lower class in front of him, with crude moves and crude routines, seemed to him as ridiculous as children's fights.
Facing the punches and kicks coming from all directions, Lin Chen remained calm and moved his steps gently.
His body shape is like a cloud in the wind, seemingly slow, but he can always avoid every attack just right.
His fists and feet brushed against the corners of his clothes and passed by his body, bringing up gusts of cold wind, but not even a single bit of fur touched him.
Several people took action one after another, but all failed, and they were all shocked.
I originally thought I could catch him, but I didn't expect Lin Chen's movement to be so agile.
"Don't give him a chance to dodge, press on him together!"
Zhao Hu looked gloomy, shouted sternly, added three more points to his hand, and made his attack even faster.
Upon hearing this, the other four immediately stepped up their offensive, taking turns with their fists and kicks, blocking all Lin Chen's dodge space.
In the small wooden house, the shadows of palms, wind and fists intertwined, and the scene looked extremely dangerous.
But Lin Chen was always calm and composed, without any disturbance in his mood.
He was neither impatient nor impatient, and moved around, taking every step very steadily, just in time to avoid all attacks.
At the same time, his eyes calmly scanned everyone, silently seeing each person's path and strength.
The cultivation of these five people is all at around the third level of Qi refining. Their foundation is shallow and their cultivation techniques are crude.
It all relies on hard work over time to polish the body, coupled with the sect's most basic breathing and breathing method, and can barely condense a trace of spiritual power.
In terms of the true way of fighting, it is not even an introduction.
After dodging for a moment, Lin Chen had figured out everyone's path, and a coldness flashed across his eyes.
There is no point in just dodging. Since the other party does not know how to advance or retreat and insists on provoking, then simply suppress it with thunder and conquer it all at once.
So as not to bother you every now and then in the future, which will only cause more trouble.
The moment another fist hit him, Lin Chen stopped dodging.
Turning sideways slightly, his right hand suddenly reached out, as fast as lightning.
Precisely clasp the opponent's wrist, use your fingertips to grasp the pulse gate.
There was a soft click, and the crack of bones reached my ears.
"Ah!"
The disciple screamed, and his entire arm instantly became numb and weak. Severe pain spread throughout his body along his wrist veins. His spiritual power was instantly scattered, and he could no longer lift any strength.
